responsibility: This machine-description fragment provides the automaton-based scheduler and latency model for the Cavium ThunderX2 CN99xx core, keyed by the "thunderx2t99" tune attribute. It defines the core’s integer, load/store, multiply, and AdvSIMD/FP execution resources and models reservations for scalar ALU operations, divides, loads and stores, scalar floating-point, AdvSIMD data processing, structured vector loads/stores, and crypto/CRC/PMULL instructions, giving GCC the microarchitectural timing data needed to schedule code specifically for ThunderX2 rather than the original ThunderX or later ThunderX3 cores.
